items.title: Andrew Morgan Interview, 1961-07-04
items.q: I'll tell you a fellow you might get a little information on it. Peter Bocca. Yes, Peter would know.

ctx.x: There were some places like the Pythian Hall and the Alhambra Club that Fess told us about.

No, I think that was before my time. It was before your time. Now, I'll tell you a fellow you might get a little information on it. Peter Bocca. Yes, Peter would know. Yeah. Either Manuel Mineta or Kit Thomas.
Yeah, well, the Fess told us this several things. We were just wondering about a couple of places we weren't sure of there.
